Looking ahead, the operating environment remains
characterised by moderating growth, regulatory
evolution, and global uncertainty. However, the Group
approaches 2026 from a position of strength.
Key financial priorities include:
• Protecting asset quality and capital strength
• Optimising returns in a lower interest rate
environment
• Commercialising strategic investments
• Supporting clients through targeted, value‑adding
solutions
The Group will continue to balance growth, resilience,
and returns, guided by disciplined execution and a
long‑term value creation mindset.
